proposal.expected_benefit: This change will strengthen the defense strategy by eliminating ambiguity in control implementation, ensuring that audit requirements are prioritized where necessary, and reducing the risk of system exploitation due to conflicting compliance decisions.
proposal.problem: The defense response fails to address the contradiction between audit status and compliance decisions, which could lead to ambiguous control implementation and potential system exploitation.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a strategy to explicitly resolve contradictions between audit status and compliance decisions by establishing a clear audit-compliance hierarchy. This should include a defined process for prioritizing audit requirements over compliance decisions when there is a conflict, ensuring robust control implementation and preventing exploitation of the system.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit-Compliance Contradiction Resolution
verification_tests: Validate that the audit-compliance hierarchy is clearly defined in the mitigation strategy.
Ensure that the process for prioritizing audit requirements over compliance decisions is documented and enforceable.
